thought euil againſt me, but God turned that into good , that he might

Ephraim vnto the third generation. Alſo the children of Machit the
ſonne of. Manaſſes were borne in Ioſephs knees. 23. Which thinys being

ſaid God wil viſit vou carie my bones with you out of this place:
